en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a landscaped cemetery with flowerbeds and trimmed hedges leading toward a monumental stone wall. On the wall is a large relief sculpture depicting an injured soldier being supported by another figure. Wide steps rise on the right toward additional stone structures. Text is printed in two lines below the image, in Latvian and French, along with a small serial number.
